name: design-arsenal
description: ONE unified frontend design skill: 7 upstream tools + 3 original modules as internal modules — one SKILL.md entry point, no per-module installation

modules.name: designlang / design-extract
modules.summary: Extract any website's complete design system (DTCG tokens, Tailwind, shadcn, Figma variables, WCAG scoring) with one command.

modules.name: Taste Skill v2
modules.summary: Anti-slop frontend art direction: researched directions from 247 gallery sites, strict bans, real-browser inspector.

modules.name: Impeccable
modules.summary: 24 design refinement commands (polish, audit, critique, bolder, quieter, typeset...) + deterministic detector rules.

subModules.summary: Core API: tweens, easing, stagger, matchMedia, reduced-motion.
Scroll-driven animation: pinning, scrubbing, snap, reveals.
GSAP + React: useGSAP hook, cleanup, SSR-safe patterns.
GSAP in Vue, Nuxt, Svelte and other frameworks.
SplitText, Flip, Draggable, Observer, MotionPath and more.
Utility methods: interpolation, media queries helpers.

modules.name: React Bits
modules.summary: 218 animated React components in 5 categories, TS-CSS + TS-Tailwind flavors, shadcn registry.

modules.name: Transitions.dev
modules.license: Free for personal and commercial use (see LICENSE.txt)

subModules.summary: 43+ production CSS transitions: badges, dropdowns, modals, toasts, AI thinking states, with motion tokens.
Polish existing motion against the transitions.dev motion-token scale.
Make UI appear as if an AI agent is generating it (wireframe-to-UI reveal).

modules.name: Playwright CLI
modules.summary: Token-efficient browser automation for coding agents: snapshots, screenshots, network, tracing.

modules.name: RTL Arabic Design
modules.summary: Arabic/RTL interfaces: logical properties, Arabic typography rules (the letterspacing ban, line-height), numerals, mirroring, Tailwind rtl:, GSAP under RTL, 10-point audit.

modules.name: Accessibility (WCAG 2.2 AA)
modules.summary: Practical accessibility gates: contrast math (zero-dep script), semantic HTML, 4 ARIA patterns, keyboard, forms, vestibular-safe motion, 12-point pre-ship audit.

modules.name: Design Tokens (DTCG)
modules.summary: Screenshot/URL/brief → tiered DTCG token architecture (primitives → semantic → component), exported to CSS variables, Tailwind v3/v4, or Figma; dark-mode-as-a-file.
